hero.title: One request. Every provider dialect. Nothing dropped.
hero.description: Send the wire your client already speaks. gproxy translates directly, preserves unknown fields, and makes every response pass through settlement.

claims.title: Many wires enter. Every response exits through settlement.
claims.convergenceLabel: OpenAI Chat, Claude Messages, and Gemini converge on one settlement funnel.

compile.title: Skipping billing is a compile error.
compile.body: Every response carries a proof token only the settlement funnel can construct. Bypass it and Rust refuses the build.

pairwise.title: No IR sands off the edges.
pairwise.body: Conversions are direct pairs between real wire formats. There is no hub schema deciding which details survive.

unknown.title: Unknown fields survive the round trip.
unknown.body: Every typed model retains unmodeled JSON. A field a provider ships today still reaches your client.

cli.title: Your CLIs stay vendor-native.
cli.body: Codex CLI and Claude Code run against pooled credentials through the same metered execution path.

providers.title: 28 providers. One base URL.
providers.body: Pool credentials, fail over between route members, and enforce spend limits per key without reconfiguring clients.

runtime.title: Native binary or wasm at the edge.
runtime.body: The same framework-free request and outcome boundary runs behind a TCP host or a fetch worker.
